subject: Mutual Action Plan: technical liaison & MAP kickoff
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@silverline.ai>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 31 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual Action Plan: technical liaison & MAP kickoff

Hi Alicia —

Thanks for the time earlier this week. To make the evaluation and commercial path predictable for both teams, I wanted to kick off a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP) thread so we can align on roles, milestones, and a firm close timeline. Ive attached a one-page MAP template to help structure the work.

Proposed MAP objectives (high level):
- Evaluation sprint: 2-3 weeks (data preparation, inference test, quality checks)
- Production proofpoint: pilot with 1-2 endpoints for smoke tests
- Close & PO: target by end of August (your team mentioned urgency)

Proposed attendees for a technical kickoff (please confirm):
- Silverline: engineering lead (customer-side) + product manager
- Redwood: Solutions Engineer (Dylan Brooks), ML engineer (Mina Haddad), and me for commercial alignment

Availability for a 60-minute technical kickoff: Aug 3/4/5 morning PT. If those don't work, please propose two times and well adapt.

Requested pre-kickoff items (short list):
- A contact who will own sample data transfer and temporary credentials
- Any compliance restrictions (IP, retention, redaction) we should know up front
- Example inference load (qps) and a representative input size (tokens)

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_Template.pdf (MAP structure)

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0142

--
From: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@silverline.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Roberts <tom.roberts@silverline.ai>
Date: Sat, 1 Aug 2026 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan: technical liaison & MAP kickoff

Karthik —

Thanks, this is helpful. Im copying our engineering lead, Tom Roberts, who will drive the technical evaluation on our side. Our priorities:
- Validate inference quality on ~50k sample utterances (dialog + search queries)
- Confirm P95 latency under 400ms for our 4kb median payload
- Confirm encryption and audit log behavior for SOC-2 demo

Tom and I are available Aug 4 at 11:00 AM PT for the kickoff. That works well for an initial MAP alignment. Well try to share a sanitized sample dataset before the meeting.

Attached: Silverline_Eval_Criteria.xlsx (basic pass/fail checklist well use)

Target commercial timeline: our procurement team is aiming to complete approvals by the last week of August. If the evaluation demonstrates parity on quality and latency, wed like to accelerate contracting.

Tom: any availability constraints on your side?

Thanks,
Alicia Gomez
Head of Product, Silverline AI
alicia.gomez@silverline.ai

Alicia / Karthik —

Thanks for looping me in. Ill own the technical kickoff and the immediate integration checklist on the Redwood side. Quick notes before the meeting (so we can use the 60 minutes effectively):

1) Logistics Ill bring to the call
- Short demo of the hosted inference flow and auth model
- Example API calls + expected payload sizes
- Capacity planning Qs (target qps, concurrency)

2) Helpful items if you can share in advance
- A sanitized sample of ~1k representative inputs (we can extrapolate results to the 50k you mentioned)
- Target SLOs for latency and throughput (P50/P95)
- Security matrix or any specific network constraints for private deployment testing

3) Rough agenda for the 60-minute kickoff
- 10m intros & roles
- 15m dataset & eval criteria review
- 20m architecture & integration checklist
- 10m success metrics & MAP milestones
- 5m next steps / action items

Ive got availability Aug 4 from 10:00-12:30 PT — 11:00 works for me. Ill add a calendar invite after we lock the time.

Attachment: (none) — will reference the MAP template and Silverlines checklist in the invite.

Cheers,
Dylan Brooks

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@silverline.ai>, Tom Roberts <tom.roberts@silverline.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 6 Aug 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan: technical liaison & MAP kickoff

Thanks all — looking forward to the kickoff on Aug 4 (Ive saved the time). A few technical points to help Silverline prioritize pre-work (so the rollout plan has clear pass/fail gates):

- Sample size: for offline quality checks wed prefer ~5k labeled examples from your 50k pool (random stratified sample across dialog types). If labels arent available, synthetic evaluation with human spot checks can work.
- Evaluation metrics: please confirm the primary metric (well set up runs for both quality and latency):
  - Accuracy / F1 for classification-like tasks
  - Rouge/BLEU or embedding-similarity thresholds for retrieval/generation
  - Latency P50/P95 (well run at target qps to measure tail behavior)
- Model guidance: to start, we recommend trying two variants: medium-latency 13B quantized and a lower-cost 7B quantized variant to measure cost/quality tradeoffs. Well surface tokenization mismatches early.
- Data transfer: if you can share via S3 (pre-signed URL) or secure Drive link thats easiest. We have a small ingestion script we can run to check format/charset.

Ive attached our internal evaluation playbook to the invite to make the MAP discussion concrete (redwood-eval-playbook.pdf). Expect a short follow-up from me after the kickoff with a proposed sprint-level MAP (week-by-week milestones).

Looking forward to it.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Staff ML Engineer, Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.ai
